confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from an unusual login to unauthorized privilege escalation, followed by cross-departmental data exfiltration and anti-forensic activity (log deletion). The sequence of events is highly characteristic of a compromised account or a malicious insider.

attack_chain.description: Successful login from an unusual IP address (91.92.109.50) which is not in the user's baseline.
Unauthorized self-escalation of privileges from 'senior_developer' to 'admin'.
Unauthorized access to sensitive finance department directories.
Exfiltration of sensitive customer data from the finance department.
Exfiltration of HR performance reviews, representing cross-departmental data theft.
Unauthorized export of the company database.
Execution of anti-forensic measures by deleting system logs (/var/log/syslog) to hide activity.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 91.92.109.50 is a known VPN or travel IP for user_02.
Confirmation of whether the privilege escalation (evt_s11_012) was triggered by a legitimate emergency maintenance ticket.
Analysis of whether the session hijacking occurred (checking if session_id sess_user_02_20260406_001 was still active during the second login).
narrative: After performing routine engineering tasks from a known IP, user_02 logged in from an unusual IP and immediately escalated their privileges to admin. The user then proceeded to download sensitive files from the Finance and HR departments and exported the company database before deleting system logs to cover their tracks.
